This channel activity is then participated in by Cacna1i, indicating a functional interaction between the two proteins. The integration of these pathways implies that Flunarizine may influence Cacna1i through its effect on the calcium channel, potentially modulating cellular signaling. The evidence supports a mechanism where Flunarizine could act as a modulator of Cacna1i function, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
